subject: Follow-up: buying roadmap and hosting/SLA assumptions
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medilabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procure@medilabs.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: buying roadmap and hosting/SLA assumptions

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap + a few clarifying questions so we can put together the right TCO/SLA proposal and a one‑page technical brief for your team: 

1) Economic buyer & procurement timeline
   - Who is the primary econ buyer / approver we should align on pricing with? (You mentioned CFO — can you confirm name and best email?)
   - You mentioned procurement review in late August — is the goal to have an SOW/contract signed by end of Q3?

2) Performance & latency targets
   - You called out sub‑second responsiveness for user flows. Can you confirm target p95 for model calls (example: 150‑250ms) and whether that is measured at application edge or from our API?
   - Expected steady state throughput and burst profile (requests/sec) will help us size Dedicated pools vs hosted.

3) Hosting preference & data residency
   - Do you have a hard requirement for private/VPC-only deployment or could a hosted (Redwood API) plan with VPC peering and dedicated capacity be acceptable?
   - Any data residency constraints (US-only, EU, etc.)?

4) Security / compliance gating items
   - Please share the security contact(s) who will receive our SOC 2 + network diagram. We can produce the SOC2 stub and a short attestation for procurement.

Next steps from our side: we’ll prepare a short note that maps: recommended deployment mode (hosted vs Private), target instance sizing (throughput & p95 expectations), and a ballpark three‑year cost range plus an SLA draft. Plan to send this by EOD next Tues (28 Jul).

Attachments referenced: SOC2_report_2025.pdf (stub) — will send full package once you confirm security contact.

Would you be able to confirm econ buyer and security contact by EOD Friday so we can include them in the SOW draft?

Thanks —

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555‑0192
[Redwood Inference]
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medilabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@medilabs.com, Markus Braun <markus.braun@medilabs.com>, Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@medilabs.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: buying roadmap and hosting/SLA assumptions

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below: 

1) Econ buyer / procurement timeline
   - Primary economic owner is Markus Braun, CFO (markus.braun@medilabs.com). Our procurement team (procure@medilabs.com) will lead contract review. We are targeting procurement sign‑off by the last week of August with a pilot PO issued mid‑August.

2) Performance expectations
   - Target p95 for model calls (measured from our app gateway to your API) is 150–250ms for the chat/generation flows. For embeddings/rerank it's less strict.
   - Current expected steady throughput for the pilot: ~300 req/sec average with bursts to 1k req/sec for short windows.

3) Hosting / data residency
   - Preference is a private VPC deployment for pilot (security is conservative). Hosted API is acceptable only if we can get a dedicated, VPC‑peered deployment and strict data segregation.
   - Data residency: US (primary) but may need EU in future — please flag implications.

4) Security contact & materials
   - Security lead: Priya Nambiar (priya.nambiar@medilabs.com). She’ll want SOC2, network diagram, encryption KMS details, and an answer on audit logs retention.

I’ve looped Markus and procurement here — Markus, happy to jump on a short call with Neha + Redwood next week to align commercial assumptions.

Thanks,
Samantha
Director of Product, MediLabs
Samantha.Lee@medilabs.com
[Attachment: MediLabs_procurement_questionnaire.docx]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:45:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: buying roadmap and hosting/SLA assumptions

Neha —

Quick internal note after Sam's reply: 

- Econ buyer confirmed: Markus Braun (CFO) — include a CFO‑level price band and TCO that shows committed vs burst cost.
- Performance ask: p95 150‑250ms measured from app gateway — assume we size for 200ms p95 on typical gen prompts as a baseline.
- Throughput: pilot 300rps avg, 1k burst — recommend Dedicated VPC pool with autoscale and burst buffer.
- Security asks: SOC2 + network_diagram + KMS notes + audit log retention (we support configurable retention).

Proposed Redwood SLOs to propose: 
- Availability: 99.95% for Dedicated pools with 30‑minute escalation windows
- Latency: p95 200ms on gen flows (with clear exclusions for large context lengths)

Action items for our deliverable:
1) Neha: produce a one‑page summary mapping deployment options + cost bands + proposed SLOs (send by 28 Jul).
2) Monica: prepare network diagram + sample KMS attestation and attach SOC2_report_2025.pdf stub.
3) Karthik: create an internal cost model for committed (3mo/12mo) vs payg and estimate burst sizing.

Keeping this short so we can include with the external follow up.

—Karthik
Director, Solutions Architecture
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medilabs.com>, Markus Braun <markus.braun@medilabs.com>, Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@medilabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procure@medilabs.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & attachments (pilot sizing, draft SLOs, SOC2)

Hi Samantha / Markus / Priya —

Appreciate the quick replies and for confirming owners. Per our internal alignment, attaching the initial packet we discussed for procurement review and the upcoming pilot planning call: 

Attachments included: 
- Redwood_tco_v1.xlsx — three scenarios (hosted dedicated, dedicated reserved, private on‑prem hybrid) with baseline sizing for 300rps / 1k burst.
- network_diagram_vpc.png — sample VPC topology for dedicated deployment.
- SOC2_report_2025.pdf — summary attestation and controls index.

Key asks for MediLabs to confirm: 
1) Pilot start target week (we have availability for a mid‑Aug pilot kickoff if procurement issues are cleared).
2) Confirmation that Priya will accept the SOC2 + network diagram as an initial package; let us know if you need an NDA or shared drive access.
3) Any hard constraints on p95 (if 150ms is mandatory rather than a target, flag that now so we can size differently).

Proposed next call: 30 minutes with Markus + Priya + Samantha + Neha + Karthik on Aug 3rd at 10:00am PT to finalize commercial assumptions. Can you confirm availability?

Thanks all — we’ll turn the inputs into a short SOW + pilot runbook and a redlineable contract draft for procurement.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
[Attachment stubs: Redwood_tco_v1.xlsx; network_diagram_vpc.png; SOC2_report_2025.pdf]
